Paper_Metadata.Paper_Title: Additive manufacturing of an ultrastrong, deformable Al alloy with nanoscale intermetallics

Raw_Evidence_Span: Bulk compression tests were performed on cylinders with dimensions of 6×12 mm, fabricated at various laser power. Specimens printed with 200 W laser (red) exhibit an ultra-high engineering stress exceeding 800 MPa concurring with substantial plastic deformability around 20%.

Composition.Note: Spherical powder with nominal composition Al92Ti2Fe2Co2Ni2 (at.%); gas atomized by Atlantic Equipment Engineering, Inc.

Process_Text.original: Additive manufacturing was performed by using a laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) instrument, SLM 125 HL metal 3D printer in Argon atmosphere with the oxygen level below 1000 PPM. Printing was conducted by utilizing a 400 W IPG fiber laser (λ = 1070 nm) with a laser power of 200–300 W, a scan speed of 1200 mm/s, a hatch space of 100 μm, a layer thickness of 30 μm and a laser spot of 70 μm in diameter. Build plate was preheated to 200 °C and each layer rotated by 67°.
Process_Text.simplified: LPBF with 200 W laser power, 1200 mm/s scan speed, 100 μm hatch spacing, 30 μm layer thickness, 70 μm laser spot, Ar atmosphere, 200 °C build plate preheat, 67° layer rotation

Structure_Text.original: Heterogeneous nanoscale medium-entropy intermetallic lamella form in the as-printed Al alloy. Colonies of nanoscale intermetallics lamellae aggregate into fine rosettes.
Structure_Text.simplified: As-built alloy features heterogeneous microstructure with nanoscale intermetallic lamellae forming rosette colonies. Specific microstructure at 200 W not detailed separately; 300 W sample microstructure described as representative.

Structure.Note: 200 W sample microstructure not individually characterized in detail; see Item 3 (300 W) for representative as-printed microstructure characterization.

Raw_Evidence_Span: Back scattered scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images reveal the microstructure of the as-printed Al92Ti2Fe2Co2Ni2 fabricated with 300 W laser power in Fig. 1.

Representative fine rosettes and cellular precipitates in coarse rosette region were characterized by scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) and energy dispersive x-ray spectroscopy (EDS) in Fig. 2.
Detailed microstructure examinations of the same (300 W) specimen using TEM and STEM are summarized in Fig. 3.

Structure_Text.original: Colonies of layered aggregates (referred to as rosettes) shown in light contrast are intermingled with the Al rich matrix (in dark contrast). Rosettes with finer laminate spacing (fine rosettes) are the dominant features near the melt pool boundaries, while rosettes with thicker lamellae (coarse rosettes) are abundant in the melt pool center. Melt pools are around 120 μm in width and 80 μm in depth.
Structure_Text.simplified: Heterogeneous microstructure: coarse rosettes dominate melt pool center (36 vol.% rosettes + 4 vol.% cellular precipitates + 60 vol.% Al matrix), fine rosettes dominate melt pool boundaries (97 vol.% rosettes + 3 vol.% Al matrix). Three major phases: Al matrix, Al₃Ti (D0₂₂/L1₂), Al₉(Fe,Co,Ni)₂ (monoclinic).

Main_Phase.Morphology: Intermixed with intermetallic rosettes; cellular boundaries in coarse rosette region

Volume_Fraction_Percent.Original_Values: 60 vol.% in melt pool center; 3 vol.% near melt pool boundaries

Secondary_Phases.Morphology: Cruciform cores in rosettes; also as alternating lamellae with Al₉(Fe,Co,Ni)₂
Secondary_Phases.Role_in_Structure: Core phase in rosette colonies; contains abundant dislocations and lattice distortion
Secondary_Phases.Note: Partially exists in L1₂ phase (space group Pm3m, a = 0.398 nm) retained by rapid solidification

Secondary_Phases.Morphology: Metastable phase retained by rapid solidification
Secondary_Phases.Role_in_Structure: Minor fraction; unstable at equilibrium, transforms to D0₂₂

Secondary_Phases.Morphology: Alternating lamellae in rosettes; also forms cellular boundaries in coarse rosette region
Secondary_Phases.Role_in_Structure: Medium-entropy intermetallic; well-mixed Fe/Co/Ni on TM sublattice; few defects in as-printed state

Fine_Rosettes.Description: Al₃Ti core surrounded by alternating Al₃Ti and Al₉(Fe,Co,Ni)₂ lamellae; Al₃Ti layers thinner than Al₉(Fe,Co,Ni)₂ layers

Coarse_Rosettes.Description: Similar structure to fine rosettes but with thicker lamellae
